page-title.purpose: Compact route identity in the header.

body.purpose: Tabs, table rows, labels, and explanatory content.

label.purpose: Metadata, timestamps, status pills, and supporting descriptions.

evidence.purpose: Recorded paths, IDs, prompts, and tool results.

components.name: Active View Tab
components.description: Stable top-level navigation with a native accent underline.
components.css: .ds-view-tab { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.35rem; padding:.62rem .7rem; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid var(--ui-accent); background:transparent; color:var(--ui-text-primary); font:650 .75rem/1.5 inherit; cursor:pointer; } .ds-view-tab:hover { color:var(--ui-text-primary); } .ds-view-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ui-accent); outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Accounting Signal
components.description: One compact cell in the four-signal overview strip.
components.css: .ds-signal { min-width:7rem; padding:.7rem 1rem; border-right:1px solid var(--ui-stroke-secondary); color:var(--ui-text-primary); font-family:inherit; } .ds-signal-label { display:block; margin-bottom:.18rem; color:var(--ui-text-tertiary); font-size:.6875rem; line-height:1.35; } .ds-signal strong { display:block; overflow:hidden; font-size:1rem; font-weight:650; line-height:1.3; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-signal small { display:block; margin-top:.15rem; color:var(--ui-text-quaternary); font-size:.625rem; }

components.name: Failure Status Pill
components.description: Compact labelled failure state; color never appears without text or an icon.
components.css: .ds-pill-danger { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.3rem; max-width:100%; padding:.1rem .45rem; border-radius:999px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive) 12%, transparent); color:var(--destructive); font:600 .6875rem/1.5 inherit; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-pill-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ui-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Selected Session Row
components.description: Evidence-dense master-list row with accent-wash selection.
components.css: .ds-session-row { display:grid; width:100%; gap:.45rem; padding:.78rem .85rem; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--ui-stroke-secondary); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-accent) 14%, transparent); color:var(--ui-text-primary); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-session-row strong { overflow:hidden; font-size:.8125rem; font-weight:650; line-height:1.35; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-session-row span { color:var(--ui-text-tertiary); font-size:.6875rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-session-row:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-accent) 18%, transparent); } .ds-session-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ui-accent); outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Evidence Table
components.description: Dense comparison table with a quiet header and tabular numeric values.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow-x:auto; border:1px solid var(--ui-stroke-secondary); border-radius:6px; } .ds-table { min-width:34rem; width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; color:var(--ui-text-primary); font:.75rem/1.5 inherit; } .ds-table th { padding:.5rem .65rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--ui-stroke-secondary); background:var(--ui-bg-secondary); color:var(--ui-text-tertiary); font-size:.6875rem; font-weight:600; text-align:left; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-table td { padding:.58rem .65rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--ui-stroke-secondary); vertical-align:top; } .ds-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom:0; } .ds-num { text-align:right!important; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Recorded Evidence Block
components.description: Bounded, scrollable monospace treatment for tool results and prompt previews.
components.css: .ds-evidence { max-height:24rem; overflow:auto; margin:0; padding:.65rem; border-radius:5px; background:var(--ui-bg-secondary); color:var(--ui-text-secondary); font:400 .6875rem/1.55 var(--font-mono); white-space:pre-wrap; } .ds-evidence:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ui-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: Hermes Session Lens is an Operate surface inside Hermes Desktop: one native observatory connecting session evidence to accounting and operational health. It inherits Hermes typography, controls, codicons, focus behavior, and light/dark theme roles; it does not establish a separate brand skin. The interface is compact, quiet, and evidence-first. A user finds a session, verifies trace and accounting, then inspects runtime, profile, schedule, or Kanban state without leaving Hermes. Progressive disclosure carries the density, while explicit provenance, bounded excerpts, and read-only language make the trust boundary visible.
keyCharacteristics: Native Hermes controls, theme roles, and codicons.
Compact borders, tabular data, and independent scrolling regions.
Failure-first ordering with restrained, labelled status color.
Stable navigation from fleet-level signals to session-level evidence.
Redacted, bounded, read-only presentation of local records.

rules.name: The Theme Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Every color resolves from Hermes theme variables; do not add hardcoded light- or dark-mode colors.

rules.name: The Label Before Hue Rule
rules.body: Status always includes readable text and, where useful, a codicon; color never carries meaning alone.

rules.name: The Numbers Line Up Rule
rules.body: Tokens, costs, counts, percentages, and durations use tabular numerals in metrics, tables, and definitions.

rules.name: The Evidence Stays Evidence Rule
rules.body: Monospace identifies recorded or generated material; it is not a decorative type choice.

rules.name: The One Evidence Pane Rule
rules.body: Narrow mode shows either the session list or the session detail, never compressed halves or stacked duplicates.

rules.name: The Stroke, Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate operational regions with theme strokes and tonal surfaces; shadows would make this native evidence workspace feel like a separate dashboard.

dos: Do preserve Hermes SDK controls, theme variables, codicons, and native focus behavior.
Do keep the four-signal strip, stable tabs, and dense evidence workspace visible in the first viewport.
Do pair failure color with text or a codicon and expose bounded evidence for inspection.
Do preserve known aggregate cost alongside an explicit unpriced-session count.
Do exclude scheduled-job scaffold prompts and system prompts from trace presentation.
Do use the 700px list→detail drill-in with Back for narrow Sessions views.
donts: Don't add a separate brand palette, external font, dashboard gradient, decorative shadow, or ornamental animation.
Don't turn dense tables into card stacks when horizontal scrolling preserves comparison better.
Don't present unavailable pricing as zero, available skills as invoked, or conservative failure signatures as certainty.
Don't expose schedule prompts, secrets, or unbounded recorded content.
Don't show list and detail together below the Hermes narrow threshold.
